title: Enriched Agent Use-Case
description: A use case with tiering, scenarios, capabilities, and value props inspired by Cowork library patterns.

id.description: Unique identifier for the use case

title.description: Display title of the use case

icon.description: Emoji or icon representing the use case

persona.description: Reference to a persona ID from the personas registry

workPatternId.description: Reference to a work pattern ID (create, distribute-collect, batch-approve, meeting-prep, listen-route)

tier.description: Complexity tier: light (simple briefing), medium (document/analysis), heavy (research/comprehensive)

summary.description: One-line summary of what the use case does

scenario.description: What this use case looks like in practice - the situational context and the agent's role

capabilities.description: List of Microsoft 365 tools, features, or plugins this use case uses

value.description: Clear value proposition - what problem does this solve and what becomes better?

narrative.description: Story-based context: the everyday problem and the outcome when this agent runs

everyday.description: The current manual/painful situation before the agent

becomes.description: What happens when this agent is running in full automation

lead.description: Key insight or design rationale for this use case

implementation.description: The four-rung structure: prompt, skill, agent, workflow

deliverables.description: Files and resources needed to run this use case

limitations.description: References to limitation IDs that apply to this use case at its current level

relatedUseCases.description: IDs of related use cases in the same catalog
